 * @param price_tick:价格最小变动单位

 */
struct FutureProduct {
  std::string class_name;
  std::string exchange_id;
  std::string product_id;
  std::string product_short_name;
  std::string py;
  double volume_multiple;
  double price_tick;

};

/*
 * 生成交易时间
 * 0: {'day': [['09:00:00', '11:30:00'], ['13:30:00', '15:00:00']]}
 * 1: {'day': [['09:15:00', '11:30:00'], ['13:00:00', '15:15:00']]}
 * 2: {'day': [['09:30:00', '11:30:00'], ['13:00:00', '15:15:00']]}
 * 3: {'day': [['09:30:00', '11:30:00'], ['13:00:00', '15:00:00']]}
 * 4: {'day': [['09:00:00', '10:15:00'], ['10:30:00', '11:30:00'], ['13:30:00', '15:00:00']]}
 * 5: {'day': [['09:00:00', '10:15:00'], ['10:30:00', '11:30:00'], ['13:30:00', '15:00:00']], 'night':
 * [['21:00:00','23:00:00']]} 6: {'day': [['09:00:00', '10:15:00'], ['10:30:00', '11:30:00'], ['13:30:00', '15:00:00']],
 * 'night': [['21:00:00','23:30:00']]} 7: {'day': [['09:00:00', '10:15:00'], ['10:30:00', '11:30:00'], ['13:30:00',
 * '15:00:00']], 'night': [['21:00:00','25:00:00']]} 8: {'day': [['09:00:00', '10:15:00'], ['10:30:00', '11:30:00'],
 * ['13:30:00', '15:00:00']], 'night': [['21:00:00','26:30:00']]}
 */
void GenerateTradeTime(const int& index, std::shared_ptr<md::ProductBase> ins) {
  switch (index) {
    case 0: {
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"09:00:00", "11:30:00"});
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"13:30:00", "15:00:00"});
      break;
    }
    case 1: {
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"09:15:00", "11:30:00"});
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"13:00:00", "15:15:00"});
      break;
    }
    case 2: {
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"09:30:00", "11:30:00"});
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"13:00:00", "15:15:00"});
      break;
    }
    case 3: {
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"09:30:00", "11:30:00"});
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"13:00:00", "15:00:00"});
      break;
    }
    case 4: {
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"09:00:00", "10:15:00"});
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"10:30:00", "11:30:00"});
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"13:30:00", "15:00:00"});
      break;
    }
    case 5: {
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"09:00:00", "10:15:00"});
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"10:30:00", "11:30:00"});
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"13:30:00", "15:00:00"});
      ins->trading_time.night.push_back({"21:00:00", "23:00:00"});
      break;
    }
    case 6: {
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"09:00:00", "10:15:00"});
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"10:30:00", "11:30:00"});
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"13:30:00", "15:00:00"});
      ins->trading_time.night.push_back({"21:00:00", "23:30:00"});
      break;
    }
    case 7: {
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"09:00:00", "10:15:00"});
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"10:30:00", "11:30:00"});
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"13:30:00", "15:00:00"});
      ins->trading_time.night.push_back({"21:00:00", "25:00:00"});
      break;
    }
    case 8: {
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"09:00:00", "10:15:00"});
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"10:30:00", "11:30:00"});
      ins->trading_time.day.push_back({"13:30:00", "15:00:00"});
      ins->trading_time.night.push_back({"21:00:00", "26:30:00"});
      break;
    }
    default: break;
  }
}

std::shared_ptr<md::Instrument> GenerateFutureIns(const FutureProduct& product, int year, int month) {
  std::shared_ptr<md::Instrument> ins = std::make_shared<md::Instrument>();
  auto ins_base = ins->instrument_base;
  auto now = EpochNanoToLocalDateTime(NowAsEpochNano(), 8);
  auto now_year = now.date_time.tm_year + 1900;
  auto now_month = now.date_time.tm_mon + 1;

  if (year > now_year) {
    ins->expired = false;
  } else if (year == now_year && month >= now_month) {
    ins->expired = false;
  } else {
    ins->expired = true;
  }
  // 生成instrument_id
  char month_s[5];
  snprintf(month_s, sizeof(month_s), "%02d", month);
  if (product.exchange_id == "CZCE") {
    ins->instrument_id = product.product_id + std::to_string(year).substr(3, 1) + month_s;
  } else {
    ins->instrument_id = product.product_id + std::to_string(year).substr(2, 2) + month_s;
  }
  // 填充必要字段
  if (product.class_name == "FUTURE") {
    ins_base->product_base->product_class = ProductClass::kFuture;
  }
  ins->instrument_name = product.product_short_name + std::to_string(year).substr(2, 2) + month_s;
  ins->english_name = product.py;
  ins_base->product_base->exchange_id = product.exchange_id;
  ins_base->product_base->product_id = product.product_id;
  ins_base->product_base->product_short_name = product.product_short_name;
  ins->symbol = ins_base->product_base->exchange_id + "." + ins->instrument_id;
  ins_base->delivery_year = year;
  ins_base->delivery_month = month;
  ins_base->product_base->volume_multiple = product.volume_multiple;
  ins_base->product_base->price_decs = product.price_decs;
  ins_base->price_tick = product.price_tick;
  GenerateTradeTime(product.trade_time_index, ins_base->product_base);
  // 填充最后交易日: 均填充为当月15日.
  // todo: 需修改为正确值
  char expire_date[26];
  snprintf(expire_date, sizeof(expire_date), "%4d/%02d/15", year, month);
  auto expire_date_time = StringToEpochNano(expire_date, "15:00:00", 8);
  ins_base->expire_date_time = expire_date_time / 1000000000;
  // 填充默认字段
  ins_base->margin = 1000.0;
  ins_base->commission = 4.0;
  ins->ask_price[0] = 0.0;
  ins->bid_price[0] = 0.0;
  ins->last_price = 0.0;
  ins->highest = 0.0;
  ins->lowest = 1000000.0;
  ins->settlement = 4000;
  ins->pre_settlement = 3500;
  ins->volume = 1000;
  ins_base->product_base->mmsa = true;
  ins_base->product_base->quote_multiple = 1;
  ins_base->max_limit_order_volume = 10;
  ins_base->max_market_order_volume = 15;
  ins->upper_limit = 8000.0;
  ins->lower_limit = 100.0;
  return ins;
}

void LocalInsGenerator::Generate(std::shared_ptr<TqApiNodeDb> node_db, int start_year) {
  for (auto& product : product_list) {
    if (product.class_name == "FUTURE_INDEX" || product.class_name == "FUTURE_CONT" || product.class_name == "SPOT") {
      auto ins = GenerateNoDeliveryIns(product);
      node_db->ReplaceRecord<Instrument>(ins);
      continue;
    }
    std::map<std::string, NodePointer<Instrument>> list;
    std::shared_ptr<Product> product_info = nullptr;
    for (int year = start_year; year < (start_year + 5); ++year) {
      for (int month = 1; month <= 12; ++month) {
        auto ins = GenerateFutureIns(product, year, month);
        auto ins_node = node_db->ReplaceRecord<Instrument>(ins);
        std::string product_key = ins->ProductID() + "." + ins->ExchangeID();

        NodePointer<md::Instrument> pointer(ins_node);
        list[ins_node->Latest()->symbol] = pointer;

        if (product_info == nullptr) {
          product_info = std::make_shared<Product>();
          product_info->exchange_id = ins->ExchangeID();
          product_info->mmsa = ins->instrument_base->product_base->mmsa;
          product_info->product_class = ins->ProductClass();
          product_info->product_id = ins->ProductID();
          product_info->product_short_name = ins->instrument_base->product_base->product_short_name;
          product_info->trading_time = ins->TradingTime();
        }
      }
    }
    product_info->instrument_list.swap(list);
    node_db->ReplaceRecord<Product>(product_info);

    node_db->ReplaceRecord<md::Exchange>(product_info->exchange_id, [=](std::shared_ptr<md::Exchange> exchange) {
      exchange->exchange_id = product_info->exchange_id;
    });
  }
}

}

template <>
void LogTapRtn(structlog::Logger& logger, const char* msg, const TapAPITradeLoginRspInfo* p, TAPIINT32 errorCode,
  TAPIUINT32 sessionID, TAPIYNFLAG isLast) {
  logger.With("errorCode", errorCode);
  if (p) {
    logger.With("UserNo", p->UserNo)
      .With("UserType", p->UserType)
      .With("UserName", GbkToUtf8(p->UserName))
      .With("QuoteTempPassword", p->QuoteTempPassword)
      .With("ReservedInfo", p->ReservedInfo)
      .With("LastLoginIP", p->LastLoginIP)

      .With("TradeDate", p->TradeDate)
      .With("LastSettleTime", p->LastSettleTime)
      .With("StartTime", p->StartTime)
      .With("InitTime", p->InitTime)
      .With("AuthType", p->AuthType)
      .With("AuthDate", p->AuthDate);
  }
  logger.Info(msg);
}
